tasks.short: Listen to mud pumps and check vibration and other problems.

steps.what: Listen to actual mud pumps and check vibration and other problems regularly
inputs: actual operating mud pumps and drilling mud system
outputs: actual sound, vibration and condition observations

steps.what: Assess actual pump observations and select required response
inputs: actual sound, vibration and condition observations
actual operating limits and immediate conditions
outputs: actual condition assessment and chosen response

steps.what: Capture and check any required actual pump inspection record
inputs: actual sound, vibration and condition observations
actual condition assessment and chosen response

steps.what: Save final actual pump inspection record
inputs: checked final actual inspection record

tasks.design: Retain actual listening, vibration checks and condition judgement. After splitting any required new inspection capture and separate save in rig inspection records {OPS_SYSTEM}, no demonstrated duplicate digital work remains to reduce.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual equipment condition must be perceived at the pump.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidenced change for the actual listening and inspection work.
tasks.still_hard: Sounds, vibration and changing rig conditions require physical assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognises an abnormal sound in its actual operating context.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: physical listening and vibration inspection require actual observations; no instrument import is established for this task.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Required inspection-record branch is conditional: remove if absent and reweight. New observations and checking are not assumed free; routine save earns no saving.

Any actual escalation, crew instruction or equipment actuation is a separate action after the exact instruction/state is checked; no avoided labour claimed. If a real repeated lookup or existing instrument transfer is found, map it before reassessing.
unknowns: Is a separate inspection record required?
research_questions: Is any actual recorded information duplicated?

incremental.description: No new system or upkeep proposed.

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final actual inspection record and destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual inspection, judgement, new record/check and save retained; no invented sensor baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare mud reports and instruct crews about chemical additives.

steps.what: Establish actual mud readings, additive usage and current crew-handling conditions
inputs: actual mud readings and tests
actual additive containers, usage and conditions
outputs: actual checked mud and additive facts

steps.what: Prepare mud reports using native fields and verified actual readings
inputs: actual checked mud and additive facts
actual rig, well, interval and product identifiers

steps.what: Interpret actual mud conditions and determine authorised chemical-handling requirements
inputs: assembled mud report
actual current additive handling instructions and conditions
outputs: chosen mud interpretation and chemical-handling requirements

steps.what: Complete and check final mud report and its exact recipient
inputs: assembled mud report
chosen mud interpretation and chemical-handling requirements
outputs: checked final mud report and actual authorised recipient

inputs: checked final mud report and actual authorised recipient

steps.what: Deliver final mud report to the actual internal rig recipient
inputs: checked final mud report and actual authorised recipient

steps.what: Prepare and check final chemical-additive handling instructions against actual conditions
inputs: chosen mud interpretation and chemical-handling requirements
actual crew and immediate conditions
outputs: checked final chemical-handling instruction and exact crew

steps.what: Instruct crews using checked final chemical-additive handling instructions
inputs: checked final chemical-handling instruction and exact crew

tasks.design: Configure native mud-report fields in rig reporting {OPS_SYSTEM} from actual operator-produced facts. Retain interpretation and complete report checking before separate save/delivery, and independently check final chemical instructions before giving them to the crew.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mud reports can repeat identifiers and fixed report structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report fields can assemble actual facts without repeated layout work.
tasks.still_hard: Chemical handling depends on actual material and conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator identifies a handling instruction that is inappropriate for the current additive or rig situation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native report fields can assemble mud facts; chemical selection and crew instruction require actual human judgement.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual operator observes/captures readings and additive facts in s1; no assumed instrument import or free transcription. Savings only repeated identifiers/layout, not new readings or scientific interpretation.

Existing report configuration earns zero new saving. Internal report route shown; if actually external, apply that exact recipient authority with final-version gate. Remove unowned delivery and reweight.

Instruction is retained as an explicit final check and separate spoken delivery, using existing checking without added self-approval time. New questions or changed conditions return to s7/s8; no unreviewed new instructions. Crew comprehension is not inferred from delivery.
unknowns: Which report fields repeat and who receives it?
research_questions: Does native report assembly reduce total effort after complete checking?

incremental.description: Maintain verified mud-report fields and references.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final mud report and rig record destination; edits void check
s4 exact final mud report and authorised internal recipient; edits void check
s7 exact final chemical instruction and crew under current conditions; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30*0.40=12 gross minus 1 upkeep; low halves gross. All observation, chemical judgement, final checks and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise crew members and assist their training.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual crew assignments and training requirements
inputs: actual crew assignments
actual training records and requirements
outputs: checked actual crew and training context

steps.what: Supervise actual crew members and assist actual training, practice and feedback
inputs: checked actual crew and training context
actual crew activity and performance

steps.what: Capture and check actual assigned supervision and training outcomes
inputs: actual supervision and training observations

steps.what: Save final actual supervision and training record
inputs: checked final actual supervision/training record

tasks.design: Configure native crew and training source links in {PROJECT}, {LMS} and {DOCS}. Keep actual supervision, training, new outcomes capture and full checking before a separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current crew and training records can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can reduce that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Crew competence and safe practice require actual observation.
tasks.human_edge: The operator sees a practical error and changes the coaching.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native crew/training links can assist preparation; attendance or a saved record does not establish competence.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Actual roster/training owners supply records and operator verifies them. Existing links earn zero new saving. New outcomes come only after actual activity.
Record only where assigned; omit unused branch and reweight. Any actual written instruction/send gets its own exact-final-content check and separate action; no avoided labour claimed.
unknowns: Which training records are available to the operator?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final actual supervision/training record and destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*0.40=4 gross minus 0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Actual supervision, training, capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated rig-report and preparation work while retaining physical inspection and crew judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Actual mud and crew records linked to source facts, with human chemical decisions and explicit final-version actions.
